headline: Add skills your resume doesn't mention, and easier reading in light mode
summary: When you tell it about a skill or experience that isn't written on your resume, you can now have it added as a fact so your tailored resume, cover letter, and match report all reflect it. Light mode also got a contrast pass so text and panels are easier to tell apart.

changes.title: Record skills and experience missing from your resume
changes.detail: If you mention something true about yourself that your resume doesn't say, you can now propose it as a fact. Once accepted, it's used consistently everywhere your resume, cover letter, and reports are generated.

changes.title: Clearer light theme
changes.detail: Text, cards, and panels have better contrast in light mode now, so the layout doesn't look flat or washed out.

headline: The first release notes entry
summary: From here on, every change that reaches you shows up in What's new — written in plain language, not commit messages.

changes.title: See what changed, without reading a changelog
changes.detail: The What's new button in the header lists each release and what it means for you. A dot appears when there's something you haven't read.
